body.summary: TALLY-02: yes to the exit question. tally --json prints one parseable JSON object per input with path (null for standard input), lines, words and characters, using System.Text.Json; output without --json is unchanged; errors stay on standard error, set exit code 1 and leave the other inputs counted. The reviewer ran all 63 tests, and pull request 3's checks pass on Linux, macOS and Windows at 0fa6f8b.
